essence: Two initiations — refinement-perfection for the knowledge-fit, with-seed release for the incapable — then the guru teaches the lifelong remainder.
Remainder threefold: daily, occasional, wished-for; the last practitioner-only, undecided here.
Daily is the recurrent; occasional is identity-with-that; its servants: twilight worship, practice, festival, thread.
Fixed-time occasional counts as daily — some say.
Occasional irregular even for insiders: guru's coming, festivals, knowledge-days — some say.
Unfailing five: fixed, twilight, guru, festival worship, sacred thread.
Twelve occasions from knowledge-gain to rule-release cause special worship.
Unwritten potent mantra by mouth-lineage alone; twilight identity-practice; daily Lord-worship on altar or liṅga.
Mirror-meditated heart-altar; own form as deity-wheel body-mirrored; full offering train; doubt-free identity.
Ceaseless mirror-gazing swiftly certifies; no order chief but identity.
Stain gone, bonds melted: the indwelling heart highest to take up — our gurus.
Ultimate-minded flashes being-flood as light — open verse.
Supreme-nectar-vision: secret-knowers worshipped by her.
Wonder-sprinkled ground; mental own-being flowers exuding fragrance.
Priceless heart-cup; you with Goddess in body-temple worshipped day and night.
Two-verse sense internalized as wheel-contemplation.
Seal-showing, murmuring, offering of that.
Dismissal through unity with the to-be-awakened.
Eat the chief offering or water-cast it; water-born already initiated — scripture-knowers.
Impure eating barred even for knowers; withdrawal alternative; altar-rite sealed.
No secret-mantra liṅga installation; manifest preferred; installed ones worshipped in order as support.
Fourteen substitutes from guru's body to mirror worshippable as liṅga.
Support-power scales mantra-success; earlier supports chief; each goal its chief — scripture-gurus.
Non-difference-pride alone highest refinement, everywhere.
Festival rule opened.
Six festival grades from rite-completion.
Festival defined: rite-completion celebrated.
Monthly, fortnightly, conjunctional, twelve monthly specials: the full calendar.
Ten star-planet conjunction pairs.
Mārgaśīrṣa-first due order minus Āśvayuja: special-special.
Another special on another festival: after-festival, they say.
Conjunctions: hour not chief.
Tithi-gain; continuity chief; after-rite, image-rite, wheel-rite synonyms.
Nine-member wheel company; collective chief worship.
Center guru, covering-order, wheel or row; Sadāśiva-vessel with Śakti-nectar wine; enjoyer-as-Śiva; triad; descent; inside-outside; re-circulation completes the wheel.
Universe-vessel; self sated with it; hand-vessel substitute; drops please vetālas, flow Bhairava; no entry; doubtless double-rite remedy; hidden-house deity-name union: hero-mixture rite.
Gift-sating close; most excellent image-rite.
Unseen-maṇḍala image-rite on festivals gains putraka-fruit within a year; for old, enjoyers, women with śaktipāta, guru-taught.
Sacred-thread rule opened.
Ratnamālā and the rest precede; Lord's command fulfilled; Tantrāloka seal: no thread, no fruit.
Āṣāḍha-to-Māgha season; Kārttika dark fifteenth double fulfillment — Nitya-tantra view.
Māgha bright fifteenth — Bhairavakulormi view.
Southern-course-end fifteenth — Tantrasadbhāva view.
Means-graded materials gold to kuśa-grass.
Four body-length threads with adhva-knot counts for God and guru; one for the rest.
Great festival and fallback courses; lapse atoned by murmuring; means-withholding disgraces knowledge.
Attained wisdom defiling the teaching: expiation case.
Statement-seal on the case.
Sacred-thread rule closed.
Festival excess-blaze calls for matching after-rite distinction.
Exposition rule opened.
Request the complete guru; expound fit text to fit disciples, even lower ones from compassion on śaktipāta-hope; secrets excluded.
Low devoted restrained seats; perfumed ground; lotus-maṇḍala with Vāgīśī center.
Common-vessel sating; sūtra-text uncontradicted; join-then-refute; section-end sating; chapter-bound.
Worshipped, dismissed, smeared knowledge-seat cast in the deep.
Exposition rule closed.
Rule-expiation opened.
Established need none; conduct-sharers get the course shown.
Woman-slaying inexpiable; Mālinī repeated to three hundred thousand till doubt falls; wheel-rite everywhere remaining.
Rule-expiation closed.
Guru-worship rule opened.
Next-day chief guru-worship; limb-only before; omission binds office.
Unqualified injunction: do it every way.
Svāstika seat; path worshipped; self offered; leavings tasted; wheel-worship close.
Guru-worship rule sealed; ahnika ends.

rasa.dominant: vidhi-śānta (calm of ordinance) with adbhuta at the wheel
rasa.justification: The ahnika legislates — days, knots, courses — and each rule lands as rest: calendar exactness settling into observance; wonder breaks through only in the wheel-rite (u35-36) and the mirror-gazing (u9-10).

sections.FUNCTION: Establishes the lifelong course after initiation (śeṣavartana): daily/occasional counts with minority views, the unfailing five, twelve occasions, mouth-lineage mantra transmission, mirror-contemplation identity, food and liṅga rules, support-power scaling, abheda-pride as supreme refinement — then the parvan calendar (six grades, conjunctions, rival school dates), the cakra/mūrti-yāga complex with hand-vessel and no-entry rules, the pavitraka system (season, materials, knot-counts, lapse), vyākhyā method (join-then-refute, chapter-bound), samaya-niṣkṛti (inexpiable breach, Mālinī count), and next-day chief guru-worship — closing the ahnika.
sections.KEY TERMS: śeṣavartana (lifelong remainder: nitya/naimittika/kāmya); tanmayībhāva (identity-with-that); vaktrāgama (mouth-lineage, unwritten); ādarśa-nyāya (mirror-certainty); parvan (festival: six grades; pūraṇād vidheḥ); anuparva (after-festival); nakṣatra-graha-yoga (ten conjunctions); cakrayāga/mūrtiyāga/anuyāga (synonyms by after-rite primacy); vellitaśukti (folded shell-hands vessel-substitute); vīrasaṃkara (hero-mixture rite); pavitraka (sacred thread: season, knots, lapse); vyākhyā (join-then-refute exposition); samayaniṣkṛti (rule-expiation; Mālinī count); gurupūjā (next-day chief worship).
sections.LOCAL CONTEXT: Āhnika 20 carries the nitya/naimittika worship code between the dīkṣā ahnikas (a14–a16) and the Kaula close (a22); parvan/pavitraka detail parallels Tantrāloka 28; the cakra-yāga anticipates Tantrāloka 29's kula-yāga. Witnesses: Pradīpaka word-by-word (sanskrit-trikashaivism), Chakravarty translation (Ishwar Ashram), vishvasa English rendering — parallels, not sources.
sections.EXPLANATION: The ahnika runs: (1) charter — two initiations, lifelong course, threefold remainder with wished-for deferred, daily/occasional counts with ke-cit views, unfailing five, twelve occasions; (2) transmission and identity — unwritten mantra by mouth, twilight practice, daily worship, mirror-altar contemplation with full offerings, swiftness without order, guru heart-doctrine, two open verses, stotra pair on ground-rite and heart-cup worship, wheel-contemplation seal, seals-murmur-offer, unity-dismissal; (3) food, liṅga, support — eat-or-cast rule, impure-eating bar with withdrawal option, no secret-mantra installation, fourteen substitutes, support-power scaling, abheda-pride peak; (4) parvan — rule, six grades, rite-completion definition, full calendar, ten conjunctions, special-special computation, anuparvan, hour-subordination, synonym triad, nine-member company; (5) wheel rite — order, vessel-filling, enjoyer-as-Śiva, triad, descent, re-circulation, universe-vessel, hand substitute, drop/flow pleasures, no-entry with double-rite remedy, hidden-house deity-name union, gift close, putraka concession for old/enjoyers/women; (6) pavitraka — rule, triple warrant, season with rival school dates, means-graded materials, knot-counts and body-lengths, festival courses, lapse and disgrace, defilement case with statement-seal; (7) excess, exposition — blaze-excess distinction, exposition rule, fit-to-fit teaching with compassion, low-seat lotus-maṇḍala, join-then-refute method, section sating, deep dismissal; (8) niṣkṛti and guru — established need none, breach punishments, inexpiable breach, Mālinī count to doubt's fall, wheel remaining, next-day chief guru-worship with office-bond, unqualified injunction, seat-path-self rite with leavings, seal.
sections.BOUNDARY: Two genuine L0 forks adjudicated (vellitaśukti hand-pose; Mālinī-mantra). Anomalous print forms kept with flags: bāṇīyaṃ (u22), makuraṃ (u22), dityau (u29), kṛtvādhāradharāṃ junction (u14), mukhyānvāpatkalpāḥ (u46), sambhavadvitto (u46), ita (u65), prāyaścittādi ending (u58), anvāpatkalpa series. Wished-for (kāmya) rite deferred in the doctrine — not reconstructed. Rival school dates recorded, not harmonized. OccultGuide/Chakravarty/Pradīpaka kept as witness-parallels only.
